# Preventive Care for R Packages

This is the well-known discovery copy for agentic assistants.

Canonical slides: https://www.indrapatil.com/preventive-r-package-care/
Root llms.txt: https://www.indrapatil.com/preventive-r-package-care/llms.txt
Root llms-full.txt: https://www.indrapatil.com/preventive-r-package-care/llms-full.txt
Source: https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/preventive-r-package-care/

Summary: A practical guide to R package development using current automation for executable documentation, warnings, portability, code quality, dependency management, sustainable CI workflows, and coding-agent readiness (also called LLM-readiness) for terminal-based coding agents. Explains AGENTS.md, agent skills, reusable prompts, keeping all three out of the package tarball, Claude Code's expected file locations, and publishing machine-readable documentation through pkgdown's llms.txt and Context7, with generic R-package examples and supporting documentation linked inline on each slide.
